revision.description:
A revision is a specific instance of the policy.
 Unpublished revisions are working copies of the policy available to a specific
 admin or a set of admins
 Published revisions are revisions that were applied to the account network.
 The last published revision is the active policy.

Legacy on/off switch for Kerberos authentication - superseded by SiteWebProxyAuthenticationConfig.method.
Kept for backward compatibility during migration; clients should move to `method` and may omit this flag.
TRUE = Proxy authentication is enabled. FALSE = Proxy authentication is disabled.

KERBEROS = Kerberos authentication (kerberosConfig.encryptedKeytab is required).
